posts.title: Ninth Rebirth: Silence and Return — What Lies Beyond Death, Does a Soul Exist, and What Does the Final Moment Feel Like?
posts.description: Where does a human life go after death? Stripped of flesh and brain, does an immortal 'soul' linger anywhere—and inside the final minute when breathing slows and the room recedes like an outgoing tide, what does departure actually feel like? Completing all eight prior awakenings by facing silence without fear is the final realm—the Ninth Rebirth.

posts.title: Eighth Rebirth: Signals and Mirage — Everything We Sense Is Information: Is This World Even Real?
posts.description: Light never enters the skull directly, sound never knocks physically upon thought, and warmth, pain, or a lover's fingertips never enter the brain in substance—every sensation is translated into faint bioelectrical signals rendered inside a pitch-black vault. If the world we inhabit is fundamentally information decoded by the mind, how 'real' is reality itself? Looking past the veil of the senses is the Eighth Rebirth.

posts.title: Seventh Rebirth: Script and Strings — Is a Human Life Already Written from Birth?
posts.description: You never chose your genes or your parents. Your era and birthplace were fixed before your first breath, and childhood wounds, temperament, and reflexes were cast before you knew how to question them. We like to believe our choices belong to us—yet looking back, is life only the faithful performance of an unseen script? Facing the strings is the Seventh Rebirth.
